name: Nathan Lambert
fame_basis: Author of the Interconnects newsletter and the RLHF Book; lead author on Tulu 3 and Zephyr; co-founder of Trillium Labs, a nonprofit for open frontier AI science.
bio: Nathan Lambert is co-founder and executive director of Trillium Labs, a nonprofit focused on the open science of frontier AI. They write the Interconnects newsletter and the RLHF Book, and previously worked on open model post-training at Ai2 and Hugging Face.
known_for: Tulu 3 and Zephyr open post-training work
ATOM Project and open model adoption tracking
